title: Distil a privileged-state teacher into an observation-only student
mechanism: train a teacher on training-only privileged state, then supervise an observation/history-only student to match the teacher's actions and/or latent on states the student itself visits

title: Use a teacher-vs-student discriminator instead of plain imitation of a privileged teacher
mechanism: train a discriminator that separates teacher from student actions/trajectories on student-visited states and use it as a reward term or to decide where to query the privileged teacher

title: Train the critic on privileged state while the actor sees only observations
mechanism: condition the value function on training-only privileged state or signals (plus the actor's history) and update an observation-only actor with its advantages; discard the critic at deployment

title: Give the reward model or judge training-only ground truth that the policy never sees
mechanism: condition the reward model or LLM judge on privileged ground-truth text (human captions/rationales, GT tool-call annotations) while the policy sees only image and prompt, and use its scores as RL reward

title: Screen candidate privileged information with a cheap statistic before training
mechanism: before committing to a privileged signal or teacher context, measure its informativeness or distance (residual dependence with return, value-prediction gain, initial teacher-student KL, PI utility) and choose by that measurement

title: Regress training-only targets from the model's own representation through discarded auxiliary heads
mechanism: attach auxiliary heads or learnable queries to the model's internal states and regress targets available only at training (privileged robot state; frozen vision-foundation-model features), dropping them at inference

title: Reward or supervise where the agent looks using the training-time location of the target
mechanism: compute a reward or label from the alignment between the agent's chosen view/region/span (camera axis, crop proposals, predicted boxes, accessed video span) and the privileged ground-truth target location, added to or gating the task reward

title: Score predicted boxes against ground truth with matching and anti-hacking terms
mechanism: reward predicted boxes by IoU/matching against GT boxes in GRPO, adding terms that block box-size exploitation (confidence, Hungarian matching, size term, IoU threshold schedule)

title: Train perception tasks with direct answers instead of think-then-answer
mechanism: for grounding, detection, OCR and segmentation, use an answer-only format reward/template rather than requiring a reasoning segment

title: Add a bonus for tool calls so outcome-only RL does not abandon them
mechanism: add a reward bonus for zoom/crop/frame tool use (usually only on correct answers, or when the query's tool-use rate is low, or per distinct coordinate) to keep the policy calling tools under outcome rewards

title: Reward or penalise tool calls by the item's estimated tool benefit
mechanism: estimate per item whether the tool or high resolution helps (base or reference model rollouts with vs without it, or in-group statistics) and set the sign and size of the tool reward from that benefit and the call count

title: Warm-start tool RL with synthesized, correctness-filtered multi-turn trajectories
mechanism: synthesize multi-turn thought-action-observation trajectories (teacher agent loop, few-shot exemplars, MCTS, templates with inserted wrong crops) or SFT on the hard items themselves, filter by final-answer correctness, and SFT before tool RL

title: Write reasoning traces from a text rendering of the image with a text-only reasoner
mechanism: render the image as text (question-targeted MLLM description, privileged markdown table), have a text-only reasoning LLM write long CoT from it with GT-answer filtering, then SFT the MLLM on (image, trace)

title: Reward perception text by whether a vision-free reasoner can answer from it
mechanism: score the policy's externalized perception text (caption, recognition block) by whether a frozen vision-free LLM reaches the gold answer from it, and use that as reward or to split credit between perception and reasoning tokens

title: Keep training items whose answer depends on the visual input
mechanism: score each item by the contrast between model performance with full visual input and with reduced or no visual input, and keep items where the visual input matters

title: Select training items by the model's own success rate
mechanism: use base or current model rollouts to drop always-solved and never-solved items, keep items with some success, keep 'median' items, or keep items failed from the image but solved from a caption

title: Weight or select gradient tokens by their image-vs-perturbed-image divergence
mechanism: compute per-token divergence between next-token distributions with the real image and with a masked/removed image (from the policy or a teacher), and use it to select, reweight or shape tokens' or trajectories' gradients

title: Add a loss on the contrast between image-conditioned and image-removed distributions
mechanism: add an objective defined on with-image vs masked/no-image distributions: maximize the policy's own divergence from its masked-image self, steer the student toward the teacher's visual log-ratio, or penalize/anchor image-free likelihood

title: Label reasoning steps by sampling continuations and checking final answers
mechanism: estimate each step prefix's value by sampling continuations to a verifiable final answer (binary search for the first error, MC success rate, dual-completer agreement) and train a PRM on it or use it directly as reward

title: Create labelled negatives by minimally editing verified-correct content
mechanism: make negatives whose label is known by construction through minimal controlled edits of correct captions, solutions, responses, prompts, or inpainted image regions, and train reward models, verifiers, judges or preference learners on them

title: Select among sampled candidates with a trained step verifier
mechanism: sample N candidate actions or solutions and pick by a process verifier or a self-critic tournament, without updating the policy

title: Inject step-verifier scores into the RL return
mechanism: add PRM or self-verifier step scores to the RL objective (per-step PPO rewards with value init from the PRM, a PRM drop gate on correct rollouts, verifier process rewards summed with the outcome)

title: Train the step verifier to write a rationale or checklist before its verdict
mechanism: fine-tune the step verifier generatively to produce a checklist/rationale and then a verdict token, and read the step score from the verdict probability, using expert or human step labels

title: Score a response's stated visual facts against a reference fact list
mechanism: extract reference visual facts (from a stronger model's correct CoT, a distilled constraint extractor, or annotated scene components) and reward or gate the response by how well its stated visual content matches them

title: Re-query the policy on its own trace with probes whose answers are known
mechanism: append an auxiliary probe with a known answer (a labelled visual claim, the same question with shuffled options) to the policy's own partial or complete reasoning trace, read its answer, and add probe correctness to the reward

title: Locate parameters carrying prior abilities and keep updates away from them
mechanism: identify parameters or directions important for existing abilities (delta magnitude and Hessian sensitivity, earlier tasks' largest LoRA positions, high-activation neurons on calibration data, gradient subspace of anchor examples) and revert, regularize, freeze or project updates accordingly

title: Limit how much and where the model moves during post-training
mechanism: restrict the update by small learning rate, LoRA-only training, frozen vision encoder/projector, per-module learning rates, or merging one LoRA per task

title: Mix diverse-format or general data into narrow post-training
mechanism: mix general or format-diverse data into narrow fine-tuning (general instruction data, rewritten answer styles, replayed general data with adaptive objective weights, batches from the other input modality)

title: Anchor replayed samples to their stored logits with a strict distance
mechanism: store each replay sample's pre-softmax logits when buffered and add a strict pointwise distance (L1/L2/L_inf) between current and stored logits to the replay loss

title: Learn the new task from the model's own samples to reduce forgetting
mechanism: train on data from the model's own distribution (sequential GRPO, or SFT on self-generated correct rollouts) rather than external targets, using base-model perplexity as the predictor of interference

title: Replace SFT with RL or preference training on the same perception data
mechanism: train on the same perception items with RL or DPO (on-policy or preference contrast) instead of supervised targets

title: Order training stages by capability
mechanism: sequence the training stages by capability (perception before visual reasoning, policy RL before critic RL, an alignment phase before hard-text mixing, domain text knowledge before agentic RL) instead of shuffling all data

title: Perturb inputs in ways whose effect on the answer is known
mechanism: augment training inputs with controlled perturbations: keep the label when the evidence is preserved (distractor concatenation, light blending, small rotation, correct or wrong text prefixes) or change the target to 'Unknown' when the evidence is masked

title: Add human-annotated short-answer VQA to instruction tuning before alignment
mechanism: mix human-annotated short-answer VQA/MCQ/grounded-caption data into instruction tuning ahead of preference alignment, and avoid augmentations that break image-text correspondence

title: Run RLVR on a self-supervised proxy task whose answer comes from the construction
mechanism: construct a proxy task whose answer is known from how it was built (corruption parameter, the span of an injected caption error) and optimize it with GRPO to train perception without downstream labels

title: Build preference pairs that differ only in the hallucinated content
mechanism: construct preference pairs that share all but the hallucinated segments (human correction of a sampled response; GT prefix completed by the image-masked policy as rejected) and optionally up-weight the differing tokens

title: SFT on rationales the model generated and filtered itself
mechanism: let the model generate its own rationales (best-PRM correct sample, contrast-rectified rationale, reasoning text from an RL-trained model on other datasets) and SFT on them

title: Reuse an RL-post-trained model's outputs or encoder to train another model
mechanism: after RL or preference post-training, export the model's captions, reasoning text or vision encoder as training material for a different model

title: Use a text LLM judge against the gold answer as the RL reward
mechanism: let a text LLM compare the final answer to the gold answer (binary verdict or a fixed step-by-step protocol) to reward open-ended answers; the judge does not see the image

title: Gate the reward on the internal consistency of the trajectory
mechanism: gate or add reward by the internal consistency of the rollout (CoT conclusion vs answer, need for zoom vs zoom made, textual CoT vs a stored grounded reference, thought vs action arguments), checked by a judge or rules without visual access

title: Reward valid coordinates inside the reasoning without checking what they point at
mechanism: require or reward syntactically valid boxes/points (and box counts equal to the GT count) inside the reasoning trace, with only answer correctness as the semantic signal

title: Put visual information back into the context mid-generation
mechanism: during decoding, re-insert visual information (copy selected cached patch embeddings, re-insert the whole image at logical boundaries, crop predicted boxes and re-answer with the crops)

title: Turn a verifier's critique into a local repair when it flags failure
mechanism: when a verifier's verdict or confidence flags a failure, convert its critique into a local repair instruction and regenerate only that segment or region

title: Train an MLLM judge or verifier with RLVR on verdict labels
mechanism: train the judge/critic/verifier with GRPO/DAPO, without SFT, using preference, verdict or ranking labels as the verifiable reward

title: Measure image use by controlled changes to the input channels
mechanism: measure how much behaviour comes from the image by removing vision, perturbing textual priors, injecting misleading text, or tracking image-removed likelihood gains during training

title: Evaluate one checkpoint under two protocols that differ only in zoom access
mechanism: evaluate the same checkpoint with and without crop/zoom access (tool-free vs tool, full image vs evidence crop, grounded vs plain prompt) and decompose the gap

title: Use attention mass per source as a proxy for which input is used
mechanism: aggregate attention weights by source token set (text before/after image, images, priors, CoT) across layers and relate them to capability changes

title: Distil the same model under a richer condition into itself on its own rollouts
mechanism: let the same model act as teacher under a privileged or richer condition (PI context, gold trace, clean image vs augmented view, terminal loop) and train the plain-condition student on its own rollouts toward the teacher's per-token distribution

title: Choose what the self-teacher sees
mechanism: decide or adapt the self-teacher's privileged context (compiled abstract hints, answer only, retrieved skill/mistake bank, evidence anchors, an adaptively truncated reference)

title: Do not apply teacher-student gaps uniformly: gate them
mechanism: filter the per-token or per-step teacher-student gap before using it (calibrate against context-induced shift intervals, set polarity by outcome sign and support, apply step weights only on incorrect trajectories)

title: Measure where privileged teacher-student gaps arise and whether they carry shortcuts
mechanism: rescore fixed student rollouts under varied teacher contexts and measure where and on which tokens gaps arise, and count shortcut evidence in trained outputs

title: Generate QA on micro-crops and re-anchor it to the full image with a training-only box hint
mechanism: generate perception QA with consensus teachers on object micro-crops, re-anchor the question to the full image by drawing the crop box, drop items the student already solves, and RL the student

title: Decompose multimodal failures with symbolic ground-truth states
mechanism: render symbolic problems into aligned diagram, text and per-atom probes; classify each failure as perception, reasoning or multimodal-specific; measure consistency across answer-preserving re-renders

title: Choose the next view by confidence-weighted Fisher information gain
mechanism: score candidate views by the log-det increase of a confidence-weighted Fisher information of the scene model, normalize gains per output, optionally restrict to a target object, and take the argmax

title: Fine-tune a VLM reward model to be invariant to task-preserving transforms
mechanism: during online RL, tune LoRA in a CLIP-style reward model so rewards vary little across task-preserving augmentations and more across negatives, optionally regularized toward Lipschitz proportionality with state distance

title: Reward a VLM agent by the error of its predicted next observation
mechanism: project the hidden state at the agent's predicted next-state text into visual feature space, use the error against an EMA vision encoder's embedding of the real next observation as intrinsic reward, update the encoder separately, and reset the projector when the loss plateaus

title: Take answering away from the searching policy and let a frozen inspector gate termination
mechanism: remove the answer action from the planner; a frozen MLLM inspector sees only the submitted span and returns a sufficiency verdict that decides termination and answering; train only the planner

title: Train a per-token good/bad reward head and reuse its backbone delta
mechanism: replace the LM head with a per-token sigmoid head trained on synthetic token labels, then optionally merge the LoRA delta back into the policy at reduced scale

title: Make Intermediate Steps Explicit and Score Them
mechanism: Force the solution process to emit an explicit intermediate (evidence, subgoal, artifact, or a governed reasoning span) and attach a direct reward or check to it, instead of crediting only the final outcome.

title: Diagnose the Bottleneck, Then Target It
mechanism: Use controlled ablations, oracle substitutions or diagnostic probes to locate the specific weakness limiting a system, then route that finding into targeted data, curricula, intermediate supervision or negatives.

title: Substitute Cheap Verifiable Signals for Expensive Supervision
mechanism: Replace costly annotated rationales or demonstrations with cheaply checkable proxy, discretized or metric-based rewards, and let reinforcement learning discover the reasoning that satisfies them.

title: Synthesize Supervision From a Privileged Exact Representation
mechanism: Replace a hard-to-process input with an exact symbolic, textual or simulator-side stand-in available only at data-creation time, let a strong generator produce accurate supervision from it, and train the target model on the raw input.

title: Manufacture Contrasts by Controlled Corruption
mechanism: Create preferred/rejected training pairs without human labels by deliberately degrading inputs, prompts or outputs (or reading the model's own error signals), then concentrate the learning signal on where the pair differs.

title: Close a Self-Generated, Verified Experience Loop
mechanism: Have the system propose or explore tasks, label its own successes and failures with an automatic verifier or environment ground truth, and retrain on the harvested experience iteratively without human labels.

title: Add a Dedicated Carrier for Intermediate State
mechanism: Insert special learned tokens, latent states or control actions into the generation process that retrieve, reconstruct or compress input evidence, so intermediate computation is carried by grounded states rather than free-form output.

title: Re-engineer the Interface, Keep the Backbone
mechanism: Extend a pretrained system to a new input type or regime by redesigning how that input is lifted, tokenized, routed, compressed or aligned into the existing interface, rather than retraining from scratch.

title: Repair a Degenerate Learning Signal
mechanism: Detect when sparse or uniform rewards collapse the learning signal and restore it by filtering uninformative groups, injecting expert or intrinsic signals, anchoring baselines, or rescaling advantages.

title: Decompose Into Separately Verifiable Parts
mechanism: Break a compositional or multi-capability task into sub-tasks, branches or modules, each with its own verifiable or cross-part reward, and optimize them jointly under one objective.

title: Measure Each Example's Utility and Select
mechanism: Estimate the real contribution of individual training examples or sources via proxies, influence, uncertainty or meta-objectives, and select or reweight the pool accordingly.

title: Recast Everything Into One Shared Format
mechanism: Convert heterogeneous signals, tasks, environments or action spaces into a single representation the base system already consumes or can emit, then train one model on the unified data.

title: Align Internal Representations to a Teacher
mechanism: Identify a property missing from a model's intermediate representations or attention and add an auxiliary objective (or small adapter) that distills it from a specialist or context-conditioned teacher alongside the main objective.

title: Constrain Which Parameters May Change
mechanism: Prevent forgetting or interference during adaptation by restricting updates to selected parameters or subspaces chosen by importance, orthogonality or separation.

title: Label-Free Preference Pair Construction
mechanism: manufacture preferred/rejected output pairs without human preference labels, and then to concentrate the contrastive learning signal on exactly the part of the pair that differs.

title: Credit the Localization Subgoal
mechanism: split a task into "locate, then answer" and make the locate step an explicit, separately credited output, so the system learns where and when to look instead of being judged only on its final answer.

title: Isolate Weak Sub-Skill, Supervise Intermediates
mechanism: show, with a controlled substitution or isolation test, that a failing system is limited by one low-level sub-skill rather than by the high-level reasoning it is usually blamed for, and then to expand that sub-skill into an explicit intermediate representation

title: Dedicated Tokens Carrying Intermediate Evidence
mechanism: stop letting free-form generated text be the only vehicle for intermediate computation, and instead insert a dedicated, learned carrier into the generation stream whose content is tied back to the input.

title: Decompose Into Separately Rewarded Parts
mechanism: break a compositional, multi-capability or multi-output task into parts — sub-skills, sub-tasks, coupled capability directions, cascaded branches, a proposal module and an executor, or heterogeneous output types — and give each part its own cheaply checkable r

title: Reward the Evidence Stage Separately
mechanism: argue that an outcome-only reward cannot tell whether a failure came from misreading the input or from faulty reasoning over it, and then to give the input-reading stage its own credit.

title: Symbolic-Proxy Data Synthesis
mechanism: sidestep the target model's weak perception during data creation: obtain an exact, text-readable stand-in for each hard-to-process input — the program or specification that rendered it, its underlying symbolic structure, the synthetic labels used to degrade it

title: Diagnose Failures, Then Target Training
mechanism: hold a base system fixed, run a controlled diagnostic that localizes why it fails, and then route that localized finding into targeted training (data, curriculum, negatives, an auxiliary stage or a narrow intervention) rather than into undirected scaling.

title: Re-engineer Alignment for New Domain
mechanism: extend a strong pretrained system to an input domain, granularity or regime it was not built for by redesigning the bridge between that input and the system's existing interface, while leaving the backbone largely frozen or lightly tuned.

title: Recast Inputs Into Native Instruction Format
mechanism: keep a capable pretrained base system largely unchanged and instead convert whatever is new — a specialist signal, a family of related input settings, a set of heterogeneous tasks, or an untapped side signal — into the one input format that system already cons

title: Cheap Verifiable Rewards Replace Rationales
mechanism: stop paying for annotated reasoning and instead let a policy-gradient objective discover the reasoning, driven by a reward that is cheap to compute and unambiguous to check.

title: Utility-Measured Training Data Selection
mechanism: question the assumption that more training data is better for an already strong pretrained system, show that the existing pool is redundant or partly harmful, and then estimate each example's (or each source's) real contribution so the pool can be selected or

title: Checkable Intermediate Artifacts as Rewards
mechanism: make the reasoning trace emit a typed, machine-checkable artifact — a restatement of the request, a set of cited evidence references, coordinates of a localized sub-region, executable assertions against an explicitly maintained state, numeric anchors that must

title: Process-Level Reasoning Reward Shaping
mechanism: treat the reasoning process itself — not only the final answer — as the object the reward governs: how long it is allowed to be, whether it is needed at all, whether it is self-sufficient, what style it takes, or how closely it conforms to reference steps.

title: Align Internals to Teacher Signals
mechanism: locate a specific property that is missing or distorted inside the system's intermediate computation — where it attends, which input stream dominates its updates, whether one input is silently ignored, whether hidden states encode a structure a specialist enco

title: Constrain Updates to Preserve Knowledge
mechanism: treat forgetting or task interference during adaptation as a problem of *where* the update is allowed to land, and to decide that location from a cheap, explicit estimate of what the existing system already depends on.

title: Restore Signal Under Sparse Rewards
mechanism: treat a stalled policy-gradient run not as ordinary sparsity or convergence but as a measurable pathology of the group-relative update itself, name its cause from group-level statistics, and insert one targeted repair at the point where the signal dies.

title: Self-Generated, Verified Experience Loops
mechanism: make the agent's own interaction the data source and an automatic check the labeler: propose or explore tasks, execute them, verify each outcome or step against ground truth that is available by construction (a procedurally generated task with a rule-checkable

title: Shared Interface Bridging Planning and Control
mechanism: choose one standardized representation that sits between high-level reasoning and low-level execution, and to make the reasoning model emit exactly that representation so either a downstream executor or the same model can act on it.
